name: ml-engineer
jd:
Machine Learning Engineer

You will build and deploy machine learning models in Python, using SQL for feature pipelines, and work with deep learning and mlops tooling in production.

Responsibilities
• Design evaluation sets and define acceptance criteria for probabilistic behaviour.
• Deploy models behind APIs with monitoring and observability.
• Partner with product on data engineering and risk trade-offs.

Requirements
• 2-4 years in software engineering or machine learning.
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or a quantitative field.
• Strong Python and SQL; experience with AWS or GCP.
• Experience with MLOps and model deployment.
